scientific_integrity: An analytic theorem with finite reproducibility tests; a previously published upper bound is expressly not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Equal three-season lengths and a cyclically moving favorable patch are assumed.
Only symmetric migration between the currently unfavorable pair is allowed.
No general migration-graph or period-monotonicity theorem is claimed.
Independence and publication priority have not been externally assessed.
title: Strict migration enhancement and exact weak-dispersal sensitivity in a cyclic three-patch model
